lines.text: Achan takes devoted things, and about three thousand Israelites flee from Gibeon, where about thirty-six of them die.
Joshua tears his clothes and falls facedown before the ark until evening, wishing Israel had stayed beyond the Jordan.
The LORD says Israel has transgressed His covenant, and the one caught with the devoted things must be burned.
Joshua has Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and Benjamin is selected, then the Zerahites, then Zabdi's family.
Achan confesses he took a cloak, silver and a gold bar, and Israel stones him in the Valley of Achor.
